Spending a full minute putting on a display, you can try to enthrall a crowd. Choose a number of humanoids within 60 feet who watch the whole performance, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one). Each must succeed on a Wisdom save (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become charmed by you. A charmed target sings your praises to anyone who'll listen and quietly works against your opponents, though it stops short of violence unless already willing to fight for you. The charm lasts up to an hour, ending sooner if the target takes damage, if you attack it, or if it sees you harm one of its allies. Anyone who saves successfully never realizes you tried at all.

You need a long rest before using this feature again.
